verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Privacy Mode, which guarantees code is never used for training by Cursor or by third-party model providers, and it is on by default for Enterprise teams. That directly delivers the core of the story. The documentation sits on an Enterprise governance page, and bring-your-own-key use carries a data-retention caveat. Missing for 10: documented steps for how individual (non-Enterprise) users enable the toggle, explicit coverage of non-code data such as prompts and chats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: With Privacy Mode enabled your code is never used for training by Cursor or other AI model providers.
Privacy Mode is on by default for Enterprise teams.
